scientific_integrity: All 53,860 finite rational dual certificates are included and checked by a standalone exact-integer program. The accompanying finite decomposition proves exhaustive relevance to real inputs; a numerical optimization program used to discover the certificates is not needed for verification. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp exact inequality only for the four unweighted cycles C6-C9; not for larger cycles, other graph families, weighted measures, or p-variation. An earlier unindexed equivalent computation remains possible.
title: Sharp centered maximal variation on six- through nine-vertex cycles
